definitions.explanation: Clothing designed to protect against cold weather, such as heavy coats, parkas, insulated jackets, and similar outerwear.

examples.japanese: {防寒着|ぼうかんぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていこう→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧なら{防寒着|ぼうかんぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: If you're going to Hokkaido, you'll need winter clothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変|か}わりやすい→変わりやすい：21113_kawariyasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{防寒着|ぼうかんぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦リュック→リュック：04541_ryukku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧おいた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Mountain weather changes quickly, so even in summer you should pack some cold-weather gear in your backpack.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{防寒|ぼうかん}→防寒：17388_boukan⟧ (protection from cold) + {着|ぎ} (clothing, wear). A practical term for any clothing meant to keep warm in cold conditions. Common in outdoor activities, travel planning, and winter sports contexts.
